caption: Windshield wipers sweep in heavy rain, and each sweep clears a sharp view of the road that blurs again as rain lands.

sa.check: Windshield wipers sweep in heavy rain.
Each sweep clears a sharp view of the road.
The view blurs again as rain lands.
Each sweep comes first and the clear view follows it.

pc.expect: The view is clear immediately behind each wiper stroke and degrades between strokes.
pc.fail: The view stays blurred behind the wiper; or it is clear with no wipe; or the rain clears itself.

pc.expect: Clearing and re-blurring alternate with the strokes.
pc.fail: The view stays clear through heavy rain with the wipers stopped; or it blurs during a stroke; or it flickers.

pc.expect: The wipers sweep in their arc and the rain falls.
pc.fail: The wipers stop mid-arc with nothing wrong; or rain falls upward; or the wipers pass through each other.

pc.expect: Raindrops are liquid that spread and run.
pc.fail: They are rigid beads; or they bounce off; or they freeze in place.
A wiper vanishes; or a third appears; or the windshield duplicates.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The car interior and the road stay the same.
pc.fail: The dashboard changes; or the road rearranges; or the wipers change.
